units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A close-up at eye level; the camera picks the plane up at its release and rises with it, easing into a settle as it climbs. A single white paper plane with crisp folded edges lifting away in one clean arc off a rooftop into an open dusk sky, the thrower's open hand still in its follow-through at the lower right, the one black corrugated-tin water tower standing on its steel legs below, clean air and open dusk sky around that one plane. Warm 2000 Taiwanese telecine grade, warm skin tones, milky lifted blacks. Visible 35mm film grain. Restrained continuous motion, camera and subject motion only.
